new_material_candidates.name: Timely Machine / Timely-RL
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Learns temporal planning through supervised cold start plus reinforcement learning and evaluates behavior under explicit wall-clock budgets in tool-heavy, agentic-ML, and interactive settings.

new_material_candidates.name: FOZO — Forward-Only Zeroth-Order Prompt Optimization
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Uses forward-only zeroth-order optimization of visual prompts for continual TTA and explicitly studies low-memory and quantized deployment regimes.

reference_or_screened.name: IMPLEMENT — Model-Based Imaginative Planning for Embodied Agents
reference_or_screened.relevance: Uses a learned world model, Monte Carlo imagined futures, and meta in-context learning over interaction history for ALFWorld embodied planning.
reference_or_screened.reason: The paper is directly relevant to E1 planning and adaptation, but this bounded search did not verify an official executable implementation suitable for governed reproduction.

reference_or_screened.name: FTAT — Fully Test-time Adaptation for Tabular Data
reference_or_screened.reason: This method is already represented by the governed FTAT candidate and therefore cannot be counted as a new E2 discovery.

reference_or_screened.name: PFT3A
reference_or_screened.reason: PFT3A was preserved in I4B10 and cannot be recounted as a new E2 comparator.

reference_or_screened.name: TALON
reference_or_screened.reason: Its governed problem is on-the-fly category discovery rather than the currently matched E3 adaptation role.

n_h2_reference_research.name: TMoW
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Recombines and adapts learned world models across unseen embodied-agent domains.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Its transfer boundary remains embodied-agent environments.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Timely-RL
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Learns time-budget-aware planning behavior across agentic task regimes.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: It does not establish transfer of one learned decision mechanism into E2 structured ML and E3 vision.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Relational Task Extrapolator
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Learns relations between tasks for extrapolation.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: No verified evidence demonstrates the same decision mechanism across E1, E2, and E3.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Learning-To-Measure
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Meta-learns feature-acquisition decisions across structured-data tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Its demonstrated transfer remains within E2 structured-data acquisition.
